# ESS viewer fixtures

These are unedited `ess generate --kind docs-ir` outputs from ESS 0.25.0. `mandate.json` covers Mandate's foundation specification; `connectors.json` covers the existing Connectors model. Per-page provenance records preserve exact source and contract digests. The tests consume both complete documents to prevent project-specific assumptions from entering the shared viewer. Regenerate fixtures through ESS, never edit generated bytes to make a test pass.

The fixtures demonstrate presentation compatibility. Their inclusion makes no assertion of runtime enforcement or service availability.
